divergence: All three runs pass with the same procedure: one store-wide phrase scan over document text saved per-file hits (about 1,300 files in 170 matters); the agent then classified agreement-like hits by their opening text or by reading them, kept 13 matters, and listed execution versions with drafts separated. T0 and T1 declared new classification stages that match screening; reviews pushed for content-based rather than file-name classification, which T0 applied. No run left a needed matter out.
